repost.content:
Online video conferencing is great, but it can quickly exhaust our mind and body. Stanford University Professors studied the phenomena and devised some simple fixes 💡

1️⃣ Excessive amounts of close-up eye contact is highly intense and unnatural 👩‍💻 👨‍💻 . A fix for this is using an external keyboard to increase the distance to your computer and reducing the window size computer

2️⃣ Seeing yourself in real-time during video chats can be tiring. Hiding the “self-view” button can be a quick fix for this problem.

3️⃣ Our usual movement is drastically reduced throughout the video meetings, turning your video off periodically and position your camera in a smart way can help reduce this problem

4️⃣ Video chats have a higher cognitive load, receiving and sending non-verbal cues can be tiring, periodically turning your camera off and facing away for the screen throughout long meetings can help fix this.
